import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                s=brand_data['weight_grams']/5, label=brand, 
                color=brand_colors[brand], alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size = weight)', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Price distribution by brand
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, 
                color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price by Brand', fontsize=11)
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(brand_prices.items()):
    ax2.text(val + 50, i, f'${val:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sensor type distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sensor_counts, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', startangle=90,
                                    colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 4. Model year vs Max ISO
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['model_year'], df['max_iso'], 
                      c=[brand_colors[b] for b in df['brand']], 
                      s=df['megapixels']*5, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Model Year vs Max ISO\n(size = megapixels)', fontsize=11)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax4.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['max_iso']), 
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

# 5. Body type count
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax5.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(body_counts)), edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Camera Body Types', fontsize=11)
ax5.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height, f'{int(height)}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Weight vs Price with body type
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
body_markers = {'Compact': 'o', 'Mirrorless': 's', 'DSLR': '^'}
for body in df['body_type'].unique():
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax6.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['price_usd'],
                marker=body_markers.get(body, 'o'), s=100, label=body,
                alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=11)
ax6.legend(fontsize=8)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
